Chadis is used once in the Rigveda,^1 and not rarely later,^2 to
denote the covering of a wagon or the thatch of a house, or
[]
something analogous to these. Weber^3 thinks that in one
passage of the Atharvaveda^4 the word designates a constella-
tion, and Whitney,^5 who does not decide whether that interpre-
tation is necessary, suggests that the constellation γ, ξ, η, π
Aquarii may be meant, since the next verse mentions Vicṛtau,
which is the constellation λ and ν Scorpionis, and is not far
from Aquarius. See also
